note: Pre-Vendetta predictions for Vendetta's nine new legends, from videos published before Vendetta was legal (31 Jul 2026), kept to grade the experts on a set whose results are known: Barcelona RQ (data/topdecks.json, published 2026-08-26), Vendetta's first. Placements are what the creator SAID in the video, read from YouTube's captions on 22 Oct 2026 (visual-only tier lists are not readable that way, so a legend placed without being said is null, not guessed). 'low'/'high' as spoken. Hand-written.

said.Jayce: 'Jace Aurora, I'm going to put this into A tier'
